focus: Dialog_EnterDungeon header rewrite (DoHeader layout, DrawCaravanInfo isCaravan:false, DrawExtraInfo text state leaks) and finder fixed ordering
diffSource: since build 16 (2026-10-07T17:23:55Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Already-entered note shrank from 40px to 24px and will wrap into the tab strip
findings.detail: The old DoInfo gave TUBAD_Enter_AlreadyEntered a 40f-tall rect; the new one is NoteHeight = 24f (one Small line) at partyRow.yMax + 4f, and HeaderHeight reserves nothing below it before the tabs. A comma list of several LabelShortCap names wraps to a second line that draws over the tab strip. Raise NoteHeight to ~40f (HeaderHeight already derives from it) or measure the text with Text.CalcHeight.

findings.title: Rescue caravan now uses IsOwner: secure slaves, guests and ghouls no longer form one
findings.detail: IsOwner rejects IsSlave, HostFaction != null and mutants whose def has canOwnCaravan false, while IsColonist accepted secure slaves. If only a slave is carried out with nobody outside, no caravan forms, the stash is flushed with caravan == null and the party-lost letter fires. This matches AnyoneStaysOutside (DungeonEntry.cs:61), so it is probably intended, but it is a player-visible behaviour change worth a changelog line.

findings.title: Everyone warning may wrap to two Small lines in a 40px row
findings.detail: TUBAD_Enter_Everyone is about 150 characters drawn MiddleCenter in an 860x40 rect. At Small font it likely wraps to two lines (about 44px) and overflows the row by a couple of pixels into the gap. This is an estimate; check it in game.
